docs/extensions.md:142:- The `🤖` line of the log shows the tools that the model gets, for example `🤖 anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 · tools: typescript · extensions: pit (typescript)`.
docs/models.md:65:    model_reasoning: true
docs/models.md:96:For Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`provider_api: anthropic-messages`) with Claude Opus 4.6+ or Sonnet 4.6+, set `compat_force_adaptive_thinking: true`.
README.md:91:| `model_reasoning` | The custom model supports reasoning (thinking) | No | `false` |
README.md:94:| `model_max_tokens` | Maximum output tokens of the custom model (reasoning counts toward it). A response that hits it with no tool call is continued, up to 3 times in a row and within `timeout`; partial text is posted, marked as cut off. If it keeps hitting the limit, pi posts an error that says so: raise this value, up to the provider's limit for the model | No | `16384` |
README.md:96:| `compat_supports_reasoning_effort` | The OpenAI-compatible custom provider supports `reasoning_effort` | No | - |
README.md:97:| `compat_force_adaptive_thinking` | Use adaptive thinking for an Anthropic-compatible custom model (`provider_api: anthropic-messages`). Claude Opus 4.6+ and Sonnet 4.6+ need it | No | - |
